title: Nickel and Hair: Allergy, Diet & Hair Analysis

seo_description: Nickel isn't a hair nutrient. What research shows about nickel allergy, nickel in food and what hair nickel levels do and don't tell you.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Old post (1,729 words, 0 study links) made unsourced claims about nickel and hair. Removed; rewritten around allergy, diet and hair analysis. Links to the existing hair mineral analysis article.
flags: The closing FullyVital product box (unchanged, sitewide) says products 'Promote Hair Regrowth'. Left for you, as with boron.
No hair-growth study exists for nickel. The article reframes it as allergy/diet/hair-test. Say if you would rather hold or merge it.
'Patch testing can confirm it' and 'check metal items' are general dermatology advice, not from the abstracts.
